name: (ADFS) LGPD/GDPR File Auditor
description: Scans managed file content for personal data patterns (CPF, CNPJ, RG, phone, e-mail, credit card, IP, passport, IBAN) to assist LGPD/GDPR compliance. Runs via Batch API or Queue/cron, tracks findings in a review workflow. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.
project_description: The LGPD/GDPR File Auditor sub-module of Advanced Filesystem scans the content of permanent managed files for personal data and records what it finds so a compliance reviewer can act on it. LgpdFileScanner reads text-scannable files (text/*, JSON, XML, CSV) up to a configurable size cap, matches a fixed set of regex PATTERNS (cpf, cnpj, rg, br_phone, email, credit_card, ip_address, passport, iban), and inserts one redacted finding per unique (fid, type, value) into the advanced_filesystem_lgpd_findings table while tracking scanned files in advanced_filesystem_lgpd_scanned. The matched value is stored redacted (first four characters plus asterisks) rather than in the clear. Scanning runs on demand through the Batch API (LgpdAuditorScanForm), or is enqueued into the advanced_filesystem_lgpd_scan queue and drained by cron or drush queue:run via LgpdScanWorker; hook_cron enqueues unscanned files on a configurable interval when automatic scanning is enabled. The results page (LgpdAuditorResultsController) offers a filterable table, a per-type summary and a CSV export, and each finding can be marked reviewed, dismissed or reset to pending and annotated with reviewer notes. All routes are gated behind the core 'administer site configuration' permission. The module detects but never modifies files; remediation is manual.
